verdicts.reason: Both fail the same way. The 'CREATIVE AGENCY' tagline is cut loose from the 'CLAYTONI' headline and pushed to the bottom. The two illustration clusters are shrunk into small, hard-cropped strips floating mid-canvas, leaving large empty navy areas above and below them. So the layout reads as scattered fragments rather than a portrait recomposition, and the art no longer frames the wordmark. A's illustrations sit closer to the canvas edges with uneven side margins. B's margins are slightly more even and its tagline sits marginally closer to the headline, so B is very slightly less bad.
